messages:
maria (eng-ml): Canary started for gamma7b-qlora-4bit at 06:12 UTC. quick sanity check shows outputs are unusually verbose and sometimes repeat lines. sample attached.
sam (serving): Which route / prompt set? any logs or sample outputs you can paste?
maria (eng-ml): Prompt: "Summarize the article in one paragraph." Output: "Sure — I can do that. Sure — I can do that. In short, the article discusses... [repeats]." Not classic loop but doubled sentences and extra framing.
jessie (devex): Saw similar in our smoke harness earlier this morning on chat-demo. Also p95 latency bumped ~15%.
leo (oncall): Any kv-cache hit rates? CPU/GPU saturations?
maria (eng-ml): Quick metrics dump: ```kv_hit_rate: 0.62 (expected ~0.95) p95_latency_ms: 212 (baseline 185) gpu_util: 67%```
ops-bot: :warning: Canary metric gate failed: quality_degradation 7.3% > threshold 5%. Canary paused.
sam (serving): Hm. Could be quantization noise or tokenizer mismatch. Is this only qlora-4bit fused kernel? Have you tried fp16 or 8-bit per-channel?
maria (eng-ml): Not yet. Repro steps I used: ```docker run --rm -e MODEL=gamma7b-qlora-4bit -p 8080:8080 redwood/infer:canary ./serve --route chat --max-tokens 256``` Then hit with sample prompt set `eval/smoke/chat_short.jsonl`.
jessie (devex): Tokenizer check: I remember gamma7b uses byte-level normalization differences. Run `python -c "import tokenizers; print(tokenizers.Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json').encode('The article...'))"` to compare tokens between weights and our tokenizer.
leo (oncall): Also run logprob distribution check for answers. If quant pushes logits spikey, sampling/temperature will trigger repeats. Command: `python -m evals.compare_logits --baseline MODEL:gamma7b-fp16 --canary MODEL:gamma7b-qlora-4bit --prompts samples/short.jsonl > logs/cmp.txt`
maria (eng-ml): Ran quick eval on 200 prompts. Results: "verbosity_increase": 6.8%, "repetition_rate": 3.4%, p95 latency +14%. Full output: ```Summary: baseline avg_length 42.3, canary avg_length 48.9, repetition_count 3 vs 0.9```
sam (serving): Can you post model artifact hash + quant config?
maria (eng-ml): model_hash: sha256:3f7a9c1b... quant_cfg: "qlora-4bit-per-tensor, fused_attn=true, norm_scale=0.05"
jessie (devex): If fused_attn is on, try turning it off — fused kernels sometimes interact poorly with qlora scaling. Also try per-channel quant (ptq channelwise) if available. I can patch the canary config.
sam (serving): Agreed. Also try running with deterministic sampling (top_k=1, temp=0.0) to see if it's sampling-induced. If repetition persists at greedy, it's model/logit issue.
leo (oncall): I'll spin a canary with fused_attn=false and fp16 fallback. Assigning to me to run: `canary/runner --model gamma7b-qlora-4bit --override fused_attn=false --fallback fp16`
ops-bot: Job scheduled: canary-3305001111-experiment-1 by leo. ETA 06:42 UTC.
maria (eng-ml): thanks. Also adding tokenizer compare and eval harness run to the job. tagging @jessie to keep devex informed. :thumbsup:
jessie (devex): I'll prepare a short triage checklist: 1) reproduce locally with smoke set 2) run tokenizer diff 3) run logits compare 4) test fused off 5) test per-channel quant 6) if still bad, rollback to fp16 and open model-onboard bug.
maria (eng-ml): Sounds good. Next steps for today: leo runs canary variant, jessie runs tokenizer/logit checks, sam will review quant config and kernel flags. I'll gather eval outputs and attach to ticket.
sam (serving): If we see per-channel helps, we should add it as a recommended quant profile in model meta.
leo (oncall): Canary finished (06:43 UTC). Early results: fused_off + qlora-4bit reduced verbosity to +1.2% and p95 latency back to +3%. Will upload logs.
maria (eng-ml): Nice. Can you upload `logs/canary-3305001111.tar.gz` and paste the key metrics?
leo (oncall): Uploaded to s3://redwood-canaries/gamma7b/3305001111/canary-logs.tar.gz Metrics: ```verbosity_increase: 1.2% repetition_rate: 0.8% kv_hit_rate: 0.94 p95_latency_ms: 190```
jessie (devex): That points to fused attn interaction. Follow-up: add canary variant test that toggles fused kernels when onboarding 4-bit models. I'll update onboarding checklist.
maria (eng-ml): Closing loop for now. We'll keep the qlora-4bit fused as blocked until we get a kernel fix or better quant config. Thanks team.
ops-bot: Ticket created: #ML-1248 "gamma7b qlora-4bit fused verbosity regression" assigned to eng-ml.
